defects.claim: Mutating the live options object returned by get changes drawing without notifying subscribers, and a later set with the mutated value is silent
defects.scenario: Create a plane with pan {x: 0, y: 1}, subscribe, then set pan.x = 1 on the object get returns: the next draw uses the new pan, no subscriber hears of it, and a later set with that pan is silent too
defects.cause: get exposes the internal mutable snapshot

defects.claim: A non-invertible view with a collapsed untiled axis still draws world copies, bypassing the finite-span guard
defects.scenario: Period 100, positive canvas size, x scale 1, y scale 0: viewportWorldRect reports infinite height, but the count and safe-integer checks accept the lattice and a callback runs for each horizontal copy under the invalid view
defects.cause: untiled-axis short-circuit bypasses the degenerate-view guard
